units.source_text: 轩端荻昨夜遭此意外之事，羞答答地回到自己房中。

en.t: Nokiba no Ogi, after suffering this unexpected incident the previous night, returned shyly to her own room.

units.source_text: 这件事没人知道，因此无可告诉，只得独自沉思。

en.t: No one knew about the matter, so she had no one to tell and could only brood over it alone.

units.source_text: 她看见小君走来走去，心中激动，却又不是替她送信来的。

en.t: When she saw Kogimi going back and forth, her heart stirred, but he had not come to bring a letter for her.

units.source_text: 但她并不怨恨源氏公子的非礼行为[\[7\]](#part1332.html#m7)，只是生性爱好风流，思前想后，未免寂寞无聊。

en.t: Yet she did not resent Prince Genji for his discourteous behavior[\[7\]](#part1332.html#m7); she was simply fond of romance by nature, and as she thought it over, she could not help feeling lonely and restless.

units.source_text: 至于那个无情人呢，虽然心如古井之水，亦深知源氏公子对她的爱决非一时色情冲动可比。

en.t: As for that heartless woman, although her heart was as still as the water in an old well, she too knew deeply that Prince Genji's love for her was nothing like a passing impulse of desire.

units.source_text: 因念倘是当作未嫁之身，又当如何？

en.t: She therefore wondered what might have happened if she had been treated as an unmarried woman.

units.source_text: 但今已一去不返，追悔莫及了。

en.t: But now it had gone past recall, and regret could no longer change anything.

units.source_text: 心中痛苦不堪，就在那张怀纸上题了一首诗：

en.t: Unable to bear the pain in her heart, she wrote a poem on that sheet of folded paper:
